facts.value: The exchange programs of the department are advertised once a year. Applications for a specific program or university are made according to the respective advertisement on the internet.
There are separate application procedures for European and worldwide programs. The advertisement and selection for the worldwide programs occur before the selection for the European programs.
If your application for a worldwide program is unsuccessful, applying for the European exchange under the Erasmus+ program is allowed without restriction.

Advertisements and selections for worldwide and European exchanges occur in parallel. Advertisements are published at the end of October with the application deadline being February 1 of the following year.
